notes.title: Highscore system update
notes.notes:
Following ever helpful feedback, we've added a clearer scoring system at the end of a win. There are also some lovely quality of life issues we're tackling such as the building placement controls and the ever expanding waves of enemies tweaking.

Stay tunes for more updates as we continue to develop Castillon!
